item.text: The database layer exposes `pttl` in milliseconds. The current code has no `getValidationExpiry` or `canSendValidation` function, and `isValidationPending(uid, email)` can return `null` when the confirmation record is missing. I’m recording the diagnosis and the edge cases a fix should cover.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
Fault localization complete. Primary file: src/user/email.js.
- isValidationPending (lines 47-56) returns "'`confirmObj && ...`, so an email-specific check can yield null instead of strict false. A live per-user marker can also outlast a missing record on some store states and still appear pending without an email argument.
- sendValidationEmail (lines 91-129) uses emailConfirmInterval (minutes) as the byUid marker TTL, hard-codes confirmation record expiry to one day, and blocks every matching resend while the marker exists. There is no emailConfirmExpiry setting use, no live TTL accessor, and no canSendValidation function.
- expireValidation (lines 58-64) removes marker and linked record when the marker still points to the code. After marker expiry, the code is unreachable from uid and can remain active until its independent expiry.
- db.pttl exists for Redis/Mongo/Postgres. It is the appropriate live millisecond timebase for getValidationExpiry, with missing/expired TTL normalized to null.
Existing tests: test/user.js covers sending/confirming, and test/user/emails.js covers pending state via the v3 API; neither covers expiry bounds, resend timing, strict false, or clearing both keys.
Suggested behavior: align marker and record to configured expiryMs; check pending state with await; return strict booleans; getValidationExpiry(uid) returns current positive marker TTL or null; canSendValidation(uid,email) allows absent pending or expired confirmation, otherwise applies ttlMs + intervalMs < expiryMs; use eligibility from sendValidationEmail; expireValidation must delete both keys before a new send. Uncertainty: emailConfirmExpiry does not currently appear in defaults.json or the admin settings template, so its default/configuration source needs review by the implementing role. Also examine partial/stale marker states and email case normalization.
EOF'

item.text:
The fault is concentrated in [src/user/email.js](/app/src/user/email.js:47). The per-user pending marker expires after `emailConfirmInterval` minutes, while the confirmation record expires after a hard-coded day. That lets an old link remain valid after pending state disappears. The email-specific pending check can also return `null` instead of a strict `false`.

The fix should add `getValidationExpiry(uid)` using the store’s live millisecond TTL, add `canSendValidation(uid, email)` with an awaited pending check and the specified `ttlMs + intervalMs < expiryMs` rule, and make explicit expiry clear both keys. `sendValidationEmail` should use the configured expiry in days for the confirmation lifetime.

Existing tests cover sending and confirmation, but not TTL bounds or resend timing. **Uncertainty:** `emailConfirmExpiry` is absent from the current defaults and settings template, so its configuration source needs to be established. I made no project source or test changes because this role is restricted to fault localization.
